_schema: LEGEND governance v3.1.1 · Annex A.1 TASK_ASSIGNMENT
OBJECTIVE: HE — Continuous autonomy and useful radar inputs: make LEGEND's autonomy durable within the roadmap (persistent revocable operator authorisation distinct from bounded pilot limits; the presidio survives the end of an assignment; operator control by integration/roadmap/urgent/stop), manage shared resources honestly, and improve the path from radar opportunities to strategic decisions and scientific results by correcting demonstrated defects only. Queued behind useful work; frozen candidates are not invalidated. ADV leads strategy, IT coordinates, SCI keeps method autonomy.
